cover.learning_purpose: Identify the lesson and its central decision at a glance.
cover.title: CS03 · Authorization & Least Privilege · cover
cover.caption: Identify the lesson and its central decision at a glance. Enforce ownership and role permissions on every protected operation.
cover.alt_text: Distinct identity tabs match only their own document sleeves, representing record ownership rather than blanket access.
cover.extended_description:
Enforce ownership and role permissions on every protected operation.

Two learners can each edit their own tasks. Changing a task ID in a request must not let one edit the other task, even though both are authenticated learners.

Being authenticated does not authorize access to another learner’s record.
cover.generation_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. BTG AI lesson cover, one high-resolution 16:9 editorial illustration. Restrained premium academic matte paper illustration, dark indigo #141724, violet and cyan accents, soft depth, strong focal subject, ample negative space for semantic UI title outside artwork. Central subject must fit inside central 40% width and 65% height, safe for 4:5 and square center crops. One metaphor and one contextual detail, no infographic. No text, letters, numbers, logos, arrows, diagram boxes, robots, brains, hooded hackers, neon or fake UI. Lesson Authorization & Least Privilege. Objective: enforce ownership and role permissions on every protected operation. Canonical example: authenticated learner A can edit their own task but cannot edit learner B's task by changing its ID. Metaphor: two neighboring personal document sleeves with distinct geometric identity tabs; a single matching shaped access token aligns only with its own sleeve and visibly does not fit the other. Secondary element: a quiet boundary divider between sleeves. Do not use a padlock. Focus on scoped fit and ownership, not security theater.
